component.name: OpenKara
component.summary: Turn your music library into a karaoke stage

description.p: OpenKara is an open-source desktop karaoke app that turns songs you already own into karaoke tracks on your computer.
It separates vocals on-device, shows synced lyrics or CD+G graphics, and stores the karaoke library in a portable local folder.

screenshot.caption: Library view with imported karaoke tracks and cover art
Player view with synced lyrics and queue controls
Setup flow for choosing a portable karaoke library folder

ul.li: Streaming playback with ring-buffer decode, chunked cache, and a bandwidth-aware low-bitrate proxy.
Saved playlists and singer rotation with round-robin queue assignment.
Faster startup and render-frame-synced playback position.
Stabilized synced lyrics with Spotify-style seekable lines.
Hardened Flatpak packaging with CI-generated SHA256SUMS.
Per-song lyric language selection with romanization for 13 languages.
Instant romanization refresh when changing the lyric language during playback.
Japanese tokenizer dictionary bundled locally instead of loaded from a CDN.
Reduced Dropbox permissions to the scopes required for remote library access.
Hardened remote library initialization, upload, sync, and reopen for Dropbox and WebDAV.
Fixed packaged macOS app startup and signing for the bundled ONNX Runtime.
